models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.hardware: single RTX 4090 24GB (DFlash2 speculative decoding in llama.cpp replacing native MTP)
engines.quant: Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL weights + Q8_0 KV cache, 90K context, --spec-draft-n-max 3, nat-spec MTP baseline 70.83 tok/s at 100K
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp dev build containing PR #27342 (--spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 3)

models.why: DFlash2 speculative decoding inside a dev llama.cpp build (PR #27342) took Qwen3.8-27B from 70.83 to 80.76 tok/s at 90-100K context on one RTX 4090 with Q8_0 KV cache, ~14% over native MTP, and 79.71 tok/s at 120K with --spec-draft-n-max 4 - at the cost of slower prefill (1750 vs 2360 tok/s).

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B

engines.hardware: RTX 5090 32GB (Strata Flash-Next GSQ-RCO, near 262K input context)
engines.quant: GSQ-RCO build, thinking off, 10 requests per condition; median decode near 262K was 81.2 tok/s on the EXL3/TabbyAPI side

models.why: Same RTX 5090, 1K to ~262K input tokens: Strata (Flash-Next GSQ-RCO) held 167.3 tok/s median decode near 262K where the EXL3/TabbyAPI setup fell to 81.2, and cut first-token wait at 128K from 52.55s to 21.08s.

models.name: Bonsai 2 27B

engines.quant: 5.9GB ternary weights, q8_0 KV cache; 60.4 tok/s reported at 245K context with q4_0/q3_0 KV, 158/164 HumanEval

models.why: bonsai-ada-surgery serves the same 5.9GB ternary Bonsai 2 27B weights at 262K-trained context on a 12GB RTX 4070: 60.4 tok/s at 245K with q4_0/q3_0 KV cache and 54 to 97 tok/s decode with q8_0 KV, with the display driven by the iGPU to leave VRAM for the context.
